description: The PXL bytecode (ADR-0009). Counts and lengths are unsigned LEB128, signed varints are zigzag LEB128, operands are fixed-width little-endian, jump targets are absolute code offsets. Codes are permanent.

opcodes.name: PUSH_NULL
opcodes.description: Push null.

opcodes.name: PUSH_TRUE
opcodes.description: Push true.

opcodes.name: PUSH_FALSE
opcodes.description: Push false.

opcodes.name: CONST
opcodes.description: Push constant k of the pool.

opcodes.name: POP
opcodes.description: Discard the top value.

opcodes.name: LOAD_ROOT
opcodes.description: Push the input named by string constant k.

opcodes.name: LOAD_LOCAL
opcodes.description: Push local variable n.

opcodes.name: GET_FIELD
opcodes.description: Replace an object with its field named by string constant k; an absent field is null.

opcodes.name: MAP_GET
opcodes.description: Replace a map with its entry keyed by string constant k; fails with missingKey when absent.

opcodes.name: INDEX_LIST
opcodes.description: Pop an int and a list; push the element; fails with indexOutOfRange.

opcodes.name: INDEX_MAP
opcodes.description: Pop a string and a map; push the entry; fails with missingKey.

opcodes.name: JUMP
opcodes.description: Continue at offset t.

opcodes.name: JUMP_IF_FALSE
opcodes.description: Pop a bool; continue at t when it is false.

opcodes.name: JUMP_IF_TRUE
opcodes.description: Pop a bool; continue at t when it is true.

opcodes.name: AND_JUMP
opcodes.description: If the top bool is false, keep it and continue at t; otherwise pop it.

opcodes.name: OR_JUMP
opcodes.description: If the top bool is true, keep it and continue at t; otherwise pop it.

opcodes.name: NULL_JUMP
opcodes.description: If the top value is null, keep it and continue at t.

opcodes.name: COALESCE_JUMP
opcodes.description: If the top value is not null, keep it and continue at t; otherwise pop it.

opcodes.name: ADD_INT
opcodes.description: int + int; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: SUB_INT
opcodes.description: int − int; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: MUL_INT
opcodes.description: int × int; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: DIV_INT
opcodes.description: int ÷ int truncated toward zero; fails with divisionByZero or overflow.

opcodes.name: MOD_INT
opcodes.description: Remainder of truncated division, with the sign of the dividend; fails with divisionByZero.

opcodes.name: NEG_INT
opcodes.description: −int; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: ADD_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: double + double; fails with nonFinite.

opcodes.name: SUB_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: double − double; fails with nonFinite.

opcodes.name: MUL_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: double × double; fails with nonFinite.

opcodes.name: DIV_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: double ÷ double; fails with nonFinite.

opcodes.name: MOD_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: Remainder of truncated division of doubles; fails with nonFinite.

opcodes.name: NEG_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: −double.

opcodes.name: ADD_DEC
opcodes.description: Exact decimal addition; fails with sizeLimit.

opcodes.name: SUB_DEC
opcodes.description: Exact decimal subtraction; fails with sizeLimit.

opcodes.name: MUL_DEC
opcodes.description: Exact decimal multiplication; fails with sizeLimit.

opcodes.name: NEG_DEC
opcodes.description: −decimal.

opcodes.name: ADD_MONEY
opcodes.description: money + money of the same currency; fails with currencyMismatch.

opcodes.name: SUB_MONEY
opcodes.description: money − money of the same currency; fails with currencyMismatch.

opcodes.name: MUL_MONEY_DEC
opcodes.description: money × decimal, exact.

opcodes.name: MUL_DEC_MONEY
opcodes.description: decimal × money, exact.

opcodes.name: NEG_MONEY
opcodes.description: −money.

opcodes.name: ADD_DUR
opcodes.description: duration + duration; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: SUB_DUR
opcodes.description: duration − duration; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: NEG_DUR
opcodes.description: −duration; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: MUL_DUR_INT
opcodes.description: duration × int; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: MUL_INT_DUR
opcodes.description: int × duration; fails with overflow.

opcodes.name: ADD_DT_DUR
opcodes.description: dateTime + duration, keeping the offset; fails with invalidArgument outside years 1–9999.

opcodes.name: ADD_DUR_DT
opcodes.description: duration + dateTime, keeping the offset.

opcodes.name: SUB_DT_DUR
opcodes.description: dateTime − duration, keeping the offset.

opcodes.name: SUB_DT_DT
opcodes.description: The duration between two instants.

opcodes.name: CONCAT_STRING
opcodes.description: string + string; fails with sizeLimit.

opcodes.name: CONCAT_LIST
opcodes.description: list + list; fails with sizeLimit.

opcodes.name: INT_TO_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: Widen an int to the nearest double.

opcodes.name: INT_TO_DEC
opcodes.description: Widen an int to a decimal of scale 0.

opcodes.name: EQ
opcodes.description: Deep equality of two values of one type.

opcodes.name: NE
opcodes.description: Negated deep equality.

opcodes.name: CMP_INT
opcodes.description: Compare two ints; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: CMP_DOUBLE
opcodes.description: Compare two doubles; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: CMP_DEC
opcodes.description: Compare two decimals numerically; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: CMP_MONEY
opcodes.description: Compare two money values of one currency; fails with currencyMismatch.

opcodes.name: CMP_STRING
opcodes.description: Compare two strings by code point; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: CMP_DATE
opcodes.description: Compare two dates; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: CMP_DATETIME
opcodes.description: Compare two instants; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: CMP_DUR
opcodes.description: Compare two durations; push -1, 0 or 1.

opcodes.name: LT
opcodes.description: Replace a comparison result with result < 0.

opcodes.name: LE
opcodes.description: Replace a comparison result with result <= 0.

opcodes.name: GT
opcodes.description: Replace a comparison result with result > 0.

opcodes.name: GE
opcodes.description: Replace a comparison result with result >= 0.

opcodes.name: NOT
opcodes.description: Negate a bool.

opcodes.name: IN_LIST
opcodes.description: Pop a list and a value; push whether the list contains an equal element.

opcodes.name: IN_MAP
opcodes.description: Pop a map and a string; push whether the key is present.

opcodes.name: NEW_LIST
opcodes.description: Pop n values and push them as a list, first pushed first.

opcodes.name: NEW_MAP
opcodes.description: Pop n key–value pairs and push them as a map; fails with duplicateKey.

opcodes.name: LIST_APPEND
opcodes.description: Pop a value and append it to the list below it.

opcodes.name: CALL
opcodes.description: Call standard-library overload f with argc arguments.

opcodes.name: ITER_INIT
opcodes.description: Pop a list and store an iterator over it in local n.

opcodes.name: ITER_NEXT
opcodes.description: Advance the iterator in local i and store the element in local v; continue at t when it is exhausted.

opcodes.name: ITER_LIST
opcodes.description: Push the list of the iterator in local n.

opcodes.name: SORT_BY
opcodes.description: Pop a list of keys and a list of items; push the items stably sorted by key, compared as comparison kind c.

constants.name: decimal
constants.description: Length, then the plain notation in ASCII, e.g. -12.50.

constants.name: money
constants.description: A decimal as above, then the three-letter currency code.

constants.name: dateTime
constants.description: Signed varint: milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00Z; then signed varint: UTC offset in minutes.

constants.name: color
constants.description: Four bytes: red, green, blue, alpha.

constants.name: map
constants.description: Count, then entries in key order: key as a string without tag, tagged value.

errors.name: budgetExceeded
errors.description: The evaluation needed more operations than its budget (PXL-001).

errors.name: overflow
errors.description: An int or duration result is outside the 64-bit range.

errors.name: divisionByZero
errors.description: A division or remainder by zero.

errors.name: nonFinite
errors.description: A double result is NaN or infinite.

errors.name: currencyMismatch
errors.description: Money values in different currencies are combined or compared.

errors.name: unknownCurrency
errors.description: A currency code is not in the ISO 4217 table.

errors.name: indexOutOfRange
errors.description: A list or string index is outside the value.

errors.name: missingKey
errors.description: A map has no entry for the key.

errors.name: invalidArgument
errors.description: A function argument is outside its domain, such as an unparsable date.

errors.name: sizeLimit
errors.description: A string, collection or decimal result exceeds the limits registry.

errors.name: duplicateKey
errors.description: A map literal has the same key twice.

errors.name: unsupported
errors.description: The function belongs to a feature group this evaluator does not implement.

errors.name: invalidInput
errors.description: An input does not match its declared type.
